rules: Committed and pushed repository content is authoritative for the implementation state.
Local uncommitted changes are not visible through the GitHub connector.
After every SSOT UPDATE, repository synchronization shall be verified.
The collaboration directory has no runtime or implementation dependency on the Turing Generator.
The SysML model shall never be manually duplicated inside repository documentation.
Documentation shall reference stable model element identifiers whenever possible.
Repository documentation may summarize model content but never redefine it.
If contradictions occur, the authoritative model always takes precedence.
